Media & Outreach

Author

Dr. Lyndon B. Duff

Media & Outreach

Communicating science beyond academia is an important part of my work. I am committed to sharing research findings with the public, engaging with community organizations, and promoting an understanding of ecology, evolution, pollinator biology, and scientific research.

Research on bees provides an opportunity to connect scientific discovery with broader discussions about biodiversity, conservation, behaviour, and environmental change.

Featured Research

Eastern Carpenter Bees (Xylocopa virginica)

My research examines the ecology, behaviour, and social organization of eastern carpenter bees, including:

  • Social evolution
  • Reproductive behaviour
  • Nest fidelity
  • Dispersal
  • Sleeping associations
  • Social networks
  • Fission-fusion dynamics

Research findings have contributed to a growing understanding of how individual behavioural decisions shape population-level social structure.
